title: Crab, Blue Swimming, Lump, Pasteurized, Refrigerated

content.title: About
content.content: Crabs are marine crustaceans that inhabit coastal waters. This product is a lump of blue‑swimming crab meat that has been pasteurized and is stored at 0 °C to +4 °C. It offers a delicate flavor, a slightly sweet aroma, and a firm texture typical of sea meat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Blue‑swimming crabs are a rare species found in cold northern seas.
Pasteurization eliminates pathogenic microorganisms, extending shelf life without freezing.
Crab meat is rich in hemoglobin, giving it a characteristic reddish hue after cooking.
Crabs can change shell color to match their environment, but the blue‑swimming variety retains its vivid hue.
In several countries crab meat is considered a gourmet delicacy served in high‑end restaurants.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Crab meat provides complete protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Compared with many seafood items, crab meat contains little fat, making it suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Rich in zinc and selenium
items.content: These trace minerals support immune function and antioxidant protection.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Crabs supply vitamin B12, niacin, and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Small amounts of EPA and DHA contribute to cardiovascular health.

items.title: Shellfish allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience severe allergic reactions to crab meat.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Pasteurized products often contain added salt; people with hypertension should monitor portions.

items.title: Bacterial contamination risk
items.content: Improper storage outside 0‑+4 °C can allow pathogen growth.

items.title: Hyperuricemia
items.content: Crabs are high in purines, which may exacerbate gout.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Crab meat can be enjoyed cold in salads, on sandwiches, or in sushi rolls, and also warmed in sauces, soups, and pasta dishes. Before eating, remove any remaining shell fragments or tough tendons.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the product in its original packaging in the refrigerator at 0 °C to +4 °C. Once opened, consume within 2‑3 days. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or changes color.
